notes: Matched F-free control for the 5% low-urban-emphasized source teacher run. Keep seed, 4096 selected source U packets, scenario assignment, simulated pairs, network initialization, 5% cap, optimizer, 1000 steps, anchors and non-teacher losses. Remove clean and anchor teacher KL; objective 0.2 normalized IQ MSE + 1.5 clean-anchor preservation.

No frozen F model is loaded or evaluated during this new control training, smoke or recovery inference. Existing LoRa real-gain frozen expert was itself trained with E104 guidance and pseudo labels; F-free refers only to incremental control training, not its ancestry. WiSig R17 is F-free. Frozen classifiers/default heads are used only for the preregistered screen after prediction.

Each dataset uses 4096 lawful source U packets: 512 clean, 1792 practical_low_urban, other five scenes 358/359 each, independently simulated with source namespace; same source samples and generator as teacher run. No U TX truth, source V, target IQ/truth/statistics enter training.

Both models use the same shared architecture and loss with independent weights and dataset-specific LoRa real-gain/WiSig R17 anchors chosen from repeatedly exposed source V. The source V panel has been used for design; it is not blind. Matched comparison may differ in numerical trajectories due to distinct GPUs.

Fixed LoRa/WiSig source V clean and low-urban packet IDs and observations, controls, two-half thresholds and stop rules remain unchanged. Any pass needs preregistered independent source replication before formal target testing; disclose actual source simulation, training cost and both experts/teachers ancestral costs.
